Overview

Kochi is a city in with a population of 335,000. A sunny coastal city on Shikoku’s southern coast, known for its vibrant Sunday market, fresh seafood, and Katsurahama Beach. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
